identity.name: Trail Medallion
identity.description: While owned, add its listed passive stats. Mana and stamina increase their per-round resource capacity; healing restores health each round, plating reduces each enemy strike, and ward refreshes each round against indirect damage. Only the listed stats are granted.
identity.lore: Its needle remembers every road its bearer finished.

effects.description: Increase maximum stamina and its round refill.

visual.brief: A thick bronze compass medallion with a blue inset and pale four-point needle. The suspension loop joins visibly to the disc; no sparkle dots.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; no colored rim lighting or isolated glints.
